errors.error_description: Within the clocked always block, a blocking assignment is used for rdata while other registers use non-blocking assignments, creating mixed assignment types in the same sequential block.
A 16-bit address input is assigned directly to an 8-bit register (addr_r <= addr), causing silent truncation of upper address bits.
The combinational always block reads 'addr' but the sensitivity list only includes state, req, and write_en, omitting 'addr'.
